_comment: fal endpoints. `verified: true` means the endpoint id was confirmed against fal's published docs; `verified: false` means it follows fal's naming pattern but should be checked on the model's page before a paid run. Every endpoint is overridable with --endpoint so nothing here is load-bearing.

draft.note: Iteration model. Get framing and motion right here before spending on hero.

hero.note: Has native audio. Disable it - we discard model audio. See blocks.json audio_policy.

i2v.note: Used for every shot with a `conditioning` block - last-frame continuity and the shared 1890/modern still. CONFIRM this endpoint id before a paid run.

tts.note: Check the voice enum on the model page for a neutral British male voice. Do NOT use a voice clone of an identifiable broadcaster - see narration.json voice.forbidden.

sfx.note: Used for the four ambience beds. CONFIRM the endpoint id. If unavailable, library ambience or ffmpeg-synthesised wind is an acceptable substitute - the beds sit at -24 to -28dB and are not doing dramatic work.
